page.layout: One printed page: running text in a single column; marginal notes with "»" marks down the left margin (the quoted definition lines beginning "ftianam" to "lúmque").

main_text.p: nis fructum, iustitiam inquam & redemptionem, non omnium promiscue sed multorum esse, nempe credentium.

Quemadmodum etiam Petrus Galatinus optime in ea Ief. verba scriptum reliquit de arcanis catholicae veritatis lib. 8. cap.14. Licet, inquit, passio Christi ad delenda omnium peccata sufficiens esse debebat, no tamen omnium peccata deletura erat: sed eorum duntaxat, qui in eum credituri essent, atque poenitentiam acturi. Eam ob rem dicit, Et ipse peccata multorum tulit. Lutherus quoq; in 53. Ief. in illud: Seruus meus iustus cognitione sui &c. definit iustitiam Christianam nihil aliud esse, quam cognoscere Christum, & hanc solam esse rationem liberationis a morte & a peccatis: hanc cognitionem liberare, nullumque aliud esse solatium. Error igitur est, liberationem a peccatis & morte omnibus simpliciter hominibus vendicare.
Idem liquidò apparet ex formula noui foederis Ierem.31. & Hebr.8. Ecce dies venient, dicit Dominus, cum pangam cum domo Israel & cum domo Iuda foedus nouum, non

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left (the "»" lines, beginning "ftianam nihil" through "lúmque aliud") are printed as the quoted definition of Lutherus and are transcribed in the text above in the main column. Page-end words "non" is a catchword-like word at the foot right. Some words in the Latin are doubtful due to the faded scan; "Ief." and "Hebr.8." are read as printed.
